label: City Pop
blueprintGuidance: Represent city pop: glossy retro-pop harmony, smooth groove, melodic chorus, and stylish nostalgia.
Keep the mood polished and urban without becoming parody.
Use mood input for night drive, neon, rain, beach, summer, or bittersweet direction.
generationGuidance: Use tight clean drums, electric bass, glossy electric piano, chorus guitar, restrained brass stabs, and analog synth support.
Keep the groove mid-tempo and buoyant with a smooth pre-chorus lift.
Use clean stereo width and polished vocal ambience without burying the lead.
Bring the hook in early for short-form output.
avoidGuidance: Avoid modern EDM drops, trap drums, heavy distortion, and overly sad ballad pacing.
Avoid long instrumental solos before the hook.
